blockers: No method paragraph: the protocol says 'your lane is the single method paragraph below', but none follows, so no scientific lane can be assigned (AGENTS.md: 'No new method paragraph is present').
Literal any-registry duplicate rule: the registered spacing-5 lattice covers 99.87% of the 37,654-dot footprint, so the 37,654-dot budget is forced to a duplicate STOP (counting bound 82.34%).
Feature stack and labels are not restored in this checkout; the competition data is login-gated.
Organizer receipts are absent; no score can be confirmed.
irregularities: IR-CC130-01 Official text says data outside the bounds must be null or nan; the repo's -zeros files write 0 outside the 5,167,373-pixel footprint. The organizer-sample mirror uses NaN outside. Zeros files are therefore a format risk and must not be uploaded without organizer confirmation.

IR-CC130-02 The owner-mirror data/sample_submission.tif has 60,988 pixels equal to 1, but the official page says the sample predicts total fault absence (all zero). The mirror is not organizer-authenticated.

IR-CC130-03 GEMSDOE25 and GEMSDOE30 top files have identical pixel values, NaN masks and grids, reported as 0.2600 each; byte hashes differ. GEMSDOE30's filename tag 91eae1ca equals the first eight hex digits of GEMSDOE25's SHA-256.
IR-CC130-04 All nine focus top files are one dot family: minimum pairwise overlap 0.973 (either direction) and minimum Spearman 0.85 across all 36 pairs.
IR-CC130-05 Front-page and executive summary generators read registry/current_run.json (historical MAGREST), while AGENTS.md names registry/release_status.json (H31-CC) as canonical.

IR-CC130-06 The repo's gate sets chance-adjusted overlap to 0 when the other raster covers 100% of random points, so an identical dense raster can pass the overlap rule; the conservative raw rule was added.

IR-CC130-07 Conflicting truth definitions: the official page says the test set is NEW faults not in the USGS database; a third-party README says catalogue pixels are masked. Unverified; needs organizer text.

IR-CC130-08 The DTI definition was re-read from the official problem page; the shell could not reach drivendata.org, so the page was read through the fetch tool. The repo's metric.py matches the page.
IR-CC130-09 Leaderboard anchors 0.3195 and 0.4413 conflict and have no receipt; GEMSDOE92 at 0.2784 is higher than the nine-site maximum and is USER-REPORTED only.

quotes: the sponsors have compiled a set of newly identified faults in the GeoDAWN region that are not included in the existing USGS fault database. These new faults have been manually labeled by fault experts and comprise the test dataset for the competition.
